rationale: Phase-2 oracle MARKERS on the real foreground lifted held-out AP@0.5 from 0.2248 to 0.4350 (whole-cell) and 0.7543 to 0.9001 (nuclei, merged 32.2 -> 8.0), locating the merge failure at MARKER COUNT. Pilot 1 changed only the flooding surface and failed to reduce merges (best -1.7%), consistent with that reading. Pilot 2 therefore changes marker generation.
mechanism: markers = peak_local_max( wm*dist_norm + (1-wm)*img_norm, min_distance=MD, labels=foreground, exclude_border=False ); elevation stays at the frozen -distance_transform_edt; cleanup stays eliminate_small_areas(50)
intensity_source: each arm's own cached reconstruction (so a q<2 reconstruction gets a fair chance to supply a better marker surface)
wm_selection: lowest mean merged count on DEVELOPMENT images subject to AP@0.5 not falling below the wm=1.0 frozen rule; aggregated over all 4 arms, never per arm, never per image
success_criteria_mechanism: on held-out images: (a) merged count falls >= 15% relative for at least one dataset, AND (b) AP@0.5 does not fall for that dataset, AND (c) split count does not rise more than 50% relative
success_criteria_qep_specific: a q=1.5 arm must beat BOTH its Gaussian counterpart (q=2/GP, identical machinery) AND the Raw arm on AP@0.5 for the same dataset
note: wm=1.0 reproduces the frozen round-3 marker rule exactly; wm=0.0 uses intensity only
